description: This file contains PHP code for generating advanced report filters in vtiger CRM, including functions to retrieve primary and secondary module columns, related fields, and handling filter criteria.

methods.name: getPrimaryColumns_AdvFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML options for primary module columns in advanced filter.

methods.name: getSecondaryColumns_AdvFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML options for secondary module columns in advanced filter.

methods.name: getRelatedColumns
methods.description: Retrieves related columns options based on selected criteria.

methods.name: getRelatedFieldColumns
methods.description: Returns related field definitions for advanced filters.
